This package redistributes the unmodified official Windows amd64 or native macOS executable.
The pinned download URL and upstream SHA-256 digest are in cloudflared-release.json.
Cloudflare did not create or endorse Pangzhu's launcher.

The Windows ARM64 package uses this same amd64 connector through Windows 11 x64
emulation. The Pangzhu service itself is native ARM64. Cloudflare did not publish a
Windows ARM64 connector in this release. Native Windows acceptance is still needed.
